title: Ingestion
description: NexusFlow SigNoz ingest volume (metrics + traces). Logs stay empty until app logs are exported via OTLP. Respects the dashboard time picker. service.name labels: nexusflow.otel-collector, nexusflow.uptime; traces use serviceName (nexusflow.dlt, nexusflow.airflow, …).

widgets.title: Metric samples ingested
widgets.description: Count of rows written to signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 per minute.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 WHERE unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Metric samples by service.name
widgets.description: Samples joined to time series labels. Blank deployment.environment is expected — we do not set that resource attribute yet.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint AND s.metric_name = t.metric_name WHERE JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'service.name') = 'nexusflow.otel-collector' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: B
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint AND s.metric_name = t.metric_name WHERE JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'service.name') = 'nexusflow.uptime' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: C
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint AND s.metric_name = t.metric_name WHERE JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'service.name') NOT IN ('nexusflow.otel-collector', 'nexusflow.uptime') AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'httpcheck.status' AND unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: B
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'httpcheck.duration' AND unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: otelcol metric samples
widgets.description: Samples whose metric_name starts with otelcol_.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 WHERE startsWith(metric_name, 'otelcol_') AND unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp}} * 1000 AND unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp}} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime({{.start_timestamp}}) AND timestamp <= toDateTime({{.end_timestamp}}) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Log records ingested
widgets.description: Expected to stay empty: NexusFlow does not export application logs to SigNoz yet (lake + metrics/traces only). Zero is correct, not a broken panel.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64({{.start_timestamp}}, 9)) AND timestamp <= toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64({{.end_timestamp}}, 9)) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
